definitions.gloss: crying voice; the sound of someone crying
definitions.explanation: The sound a person makes when crying, or a voice choked with tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泣|な}き{声|ごえ}
⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{泣|な}き{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear crying from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こうで、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泣|な}き{声|ごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: On the other end of the phone, my mother said 'thank you' in a tearful voice.

notes:
Built on ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry). Only people cry with {泣|な}き{声|ごえ}; the calls of animals and birds are ⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧, same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear crying
- {泣|な}き{声|ごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to cry out, to burst into tears
- {泣|な}き{声|ごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in a tearful voice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧: the cry or call of an animal or bird
- ⟦{産声|うぶごえ}→産声：13536_ubugoe⟧: a newborn baby's first cry
